item.title: Add .doc-standard.yaml schema file for doc structure enforcement
item.intent: The repo must declare its doc standard version and structure so automated checks can validate compliance — undeclared standards are unenforceable.
item.description: This is part of a cross-repo documentation standard (see repo-docs-system.md in the std-docs repo). The .doc-standard.yaml file declares: schema version, project metadata (name, tagline, category), required files list, cross-repo links to sibling projects (ClawHQ, Easy-Markdown, GigOS), and author info for consistency enforcement. This file enables a future GitHub Action (doc-check.yml) to validate that all required docs exist and the README follows the template structure. The schema is lightweight — under 30 lines of YAML.
steps: Set project name to 'aishore', tagline to 'Autonomous sprint orchestration for Claude Code', category to 'tool'

List required_files matching the docs/ structure: README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/QUICKSTART.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md, docs/PROBLEMS.md, docs/ROADMAP.md, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/CHANGELOG.md
Add portfolio section with sibling repos: ClawHQ (complementary), Easy-Markdown (related), GigOS (related)
Add author section: name Simon Plant, location Santa Barbara CA, status 'Building AI infrastructure tools. Open to roles.'
Verify the file is valid YAML
acceptanceCriteria: .doc-standard.yaml exists at repo root and is valid YAML
File declares schema_version, project metadata, required_files list, portfolio sibling repos, and author info
required_files list matches the actual docs/ file structure created by FEAT-014 through FEAT-020
Portfolio section lists ClawHQ, Easy-Markdown, and GigOS with correct GitHub URLs
